##

## 

- **Purpose**

    - Utilize descriptive statistics and single variable visualization techniques for summarizing and exploring a data set.
    
# Weekly store data

## {.smaller}

-   **storeNum**: store identifier
-   **Year**: year identifier
-   **Week**: week as it would appear in the ISO 8601 system (1-52)
-   **p1sales**: units sold of product 1
-   **p2sales**: units sold of product 2
-   **p1price**: price of product 1
-   **p2price**: price of product 2
-   **p1prom**: whether product 1 was promoted (1) or not (0)
-   **p2prom**: whether product 2 was promoted (1) or not (0)
-   **country**: two-letter country codes defined in ISO 3166-1

## {.smaller .center}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: "|1-3|"
weekly_store <- read_csv(
  file = "http://goo.gl/QPDdMl"
)

weekly_store |> head(n = 5)
```
:::
::: {.column width="30%"}
-   **Import data**
:::
::::

## {.smaller .center}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: "|2-8|"
weekly_store <- weekly_store |>
  mutate(
    storeNum = factor(storeNum, ordered = FALSE),
    Year = factor(Year, levels = 1:2, ordered = TRUE),
    Week = factor(Week, levels = 1:52, ordered = TRUE),
    p1prom = as.logical(p1prom),
    p2prom = as.logical(p2prom)
  )

weekly_store |> head(n = 5)
```
:::
::: {.column width="30%"}
-   **Transform data**
:::
::::

## {.smaller .center}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: "|2|"
weekly_store |>
  glimpse()
```
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
-   **Inspect data**

    - the tidyverse way
:::
::::

## {.smaller .center}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
```{r}
#| eval: false
#| code-line-numbers: "|2|"
weekly_store |>
  skim()
```
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
-   **Summarize data** 

    - the `skimr` way
    - Ups the table is really big!!! Try it in your console to see the complete table
:::
::::

## {.smaller .center}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: "|2|"
weekly_store |>
  count(p1price)
```
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
-   **Count data**
 
    - the tidyverse way
:::
::::

## {.smaller .center}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
- **Histograms**

  - the tidyverse way
```{r}
#| eval: false
#| code-line-numbers: "|3-8|"
weekly_store_hist <- weekly_store |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(
    aes(x = p1sales, y = after_stat(density)),
    color = "black",
    fill = "lightblue",
    bins = 30
  )

weekly_store_hist
```
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
\
\
```{r}

#| fig-cap: Using `geom_histogram()` to apply a geometry
#| echo: false

  ggplot() +
  geom_histogram(
    aes(x = p1sales, y = after_stat(density)),
    color = "black",
    fill = "lightblue",
    bins = 30

weekly_store_hist
```

# Questions and answers with data

## {.smaller .center}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="70%"}
-   **In what countries the company sell more units of product 2?**
```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: "|2|"
weekly_store_sales_by_country <- weekly_store |>
  group_by(country)

weekly_store_sales_by_country
```
:::
::: {.column width="30%"}
\
\

-   Preparing the data
:::
::::

## {.smaller .center}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
-   **In what countries the company sell more units of product 2?**
```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: "|3|"
weekly_store_sales_by_country <- weekly_store |>
  group_by(country) |>
  summarise(sum_p2sales = sum(p2sales))

weekly_store_sales_by_country
```
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
\
\

-   Preparing the data
:::
::::

## {.smaller .center}

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="50%"}
-   **In what countries the company sell more units of product 2?**

```{r}
#| code-line-numbers: "|4-9|"
weekly_store_sales_by_country <- weekly_store |>
  group_by(country) |>
  summarise(sum_p2sales = sum(p2sales)) |>
  mutate(
    country = fct_reorder(
      .f = country,
      .x = sum_p2sales
    )
  )

weekly_store_sales_by_country
```
:::
::: {.column width="50%"}
\
\

-   Preparing the data
:::
::::

```{r}
  geom_col(
```
```{r}
    aes(x = country, y = sum_p2sales, fill = country),
    color = "black",
    show.legend = FALSE
```
```{r}
  ) +

    labels = c(
```
